About Akornafa

Akornafa is a dignified platform for families to announce a funeral, share a memorial page, and gather tributes and condolences from loved ones near and far.

We believe every life deserves to be honoured with respect and care. Our platform gives families a private space to celebrate their loved one's story with photographs, tributes, and memories — controlled entirely by the family.

Akornafa is a product of Hoganam Ltd., based in Ghana.

Honouring lives. Preserving memories.
